text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. gave it everything she had. 
Though the Triple Crown slipped from her 
grasp, the crowd sensed her immense 
potential and looked forward to her 
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They said Mr. C.B. would go on to rack up 
consecutive GⅠ wins, and might even 
surpass "the Myth."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Katsuragi Ace says her 
eyes have been opened. Mr. C.B. wasn't 
just a wall—she was a formidable rival. 
Merely wanting to surpass her isn't enough 
to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That they must be beaten to a pulp. Mr. 
C.B. was delighted by those words. And 
with that, the two shared a firm 
handshake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mr. C.B. expressed her wish for 
a fiery GⅠ race against strong Umamusume. 
Her next goal was set for the Takarazuka 
Kinen.
